code-formatter.name: Code Formatter
code-formatter.description: Format JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, SCSS, HTML, JSON, YAML and Markdown with Prettier, locally.
code-formatter.keywords: format, beautify, indent, pretty print, prettier

color-converter.name: Color Converter
color-converter.description: Convert colors between hex, rgb(a) and hsl(a), with a live swatch, locally.
color-converter.keywords: color, colour, color code, color picker, hex, rgb, hsl
color-converter.unrecognized: Unrecognized color. Try #hex, rgb() or hsl().

config-validator.name: Config Validator
config-validator.description: Validate YAML, Docker Compose and Kubernetes manifests for structure and common mistakes, locally.
config-validator.keywords: config, validate, configuration file, manifest, yaml, docker compose, kubernetes, k8s

issues.topLevelMapping: Top-level document must be a mapping.
issues.versionObsolete: The top-level `version` field is obsolete in the Compose spec.

device-information.name: Device Information
device-information.description: See what your browser exposes: screen, viewport, platform, languages and more, locally.
device-information.keywords: device, screen resolution, browser, viewport, pixel ratio, hardware

email-normalizer.name: Email Normalizer
email-normalizer.description: Reduce emails to a canonical form (Gmail dots and +tags) to spot duplicates, locally.
email-normalizer.keywords: email, e-mail, mail, gmail, duplicate, normalize, canonical
email-normalizer.help: Gmail ignores dots and anything after +; other providers usually only ignore the + tag. Use this to detect duplicate signups, not to validate deliverability.

html-wysiwyg-editor.name: HTML WYSIWYG Editor
html-wysiwyg-editor.description: Write rich text with a toolbar and get clean HTML out, locally.
html-wysiwyg-editor.keywords: rich text, text editor, html editor, formatting, wysiwyg

http-mime.name: HTTP Status & MIME Lookup
http-mime.description: Look up HTTP status codes and MIME types with quick search, all local reference.
http-mime.keywords: status code, content type, file extension, error code, http, mime, content-type, 404

keycode-info.name: Keycode Info
keycode-info.description: Press any key to see its JavaScript event.key, code, keyCode and modifiers, locally.
keycode-info.keywords: key, keyboard, keycode, shortcut, keydown, event.key
keycode-info.prompt: Press any key (this panel must be focused / the page active)…

meta-tag-generator.name: Meta Tag Generator
meta-tag-generator.description: Generate SEO, OpenGraph and Twitter meta tags from a few fields, locally.
meta-tag-generator.keywords: meta tags, tags, social sharing, preview, seo, opengraph, og, twitter card

openapi.name: OpenAPI Viewer
openapi.description: Explore an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (JSON or YAML) and generate C# models from its schemas, locally.
openapi.keywords: spec, schema, model, api, openapi, swagger, c#
openapi.summary: OpenAPI {value} · {count, plural, one {# operation} other {# operations}} · {total, plural, one {# schema} other {# schemas}}

query-string.name: Query String Builder
query-string.description: Build a URL query string from JSON parameters and parse one back to JSON, locally.
query-string.keywords: query, query string, url parameters, params, querystring
query-string.notObject: Provide a JSON object of parameters.

safelink-decoder.name: SafeLink Decoder
safelink-decoder.description: Unwrap Outlook SafeLinks and similar redirect URLs to reveal the real destination, locally.
safelink-decoder.keywords: redirect, decode link, safe link, real address, safelink, outlook
safelink-decoder.warning: Decoding only reveals where a link points. Always judge whether the destination is trustworthy before opening it.

errors.notUrl: That doesn't look like a URL.
errors.notFound: No wrapped URL found (expected a `url=` style parameter).

slugify-string.name: Slugify String
slugify-string.description: Turn text into a clean, URL-safe slug, stripping accents and punctuation, locally.
slugify-string.keywords: short name, permanent link, accents, url, slug, slugify, permalink, seo

url-encode.name: URL Encode / Decode
url-encode.description: Percent-encode or decode text and URLs, component-wise or whole, all local.
url-encode.keywords: encode, decode, percent encoding, url, uri, escape, querystring

url-parser.name: URL Parser
url-parser.description: Break a URL into protocol, host, path, query parameters and fragment, locally.
url-parser.keywords: parse, query, params, host, path, url, uri, querystring

user-agent-parser.name: User-Agent Parser
user-agent-parser.description: Break a User-Agent string into browser, engine, OS and device, locally.
user-agent-parser.keywords: browser, operating system, device, parse, user agent, ua
